actions.name: proboscis
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a creature, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} attaches to the target. While attached, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't make Proboscis attacks, and the target takes [[/damage average activity=5xwoPMBiaRBqjFav]] damage at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} as an action.
